siteName: Gale Crater — Bradbury Landing & Aeolis Palus

provenance.datasetName: Mars MSL Gale Merged DEM 1m v3
provenance.provider: USGS Astrogeology Science Center / NASA PDS
provenance.instrumentOrMission: MRO HiRISE + CTX + Mars Express HRSC + MGS MOLA reference
provenance.processingPerformed: Bounded 3.84 km x 3.84 km subset (x: 8144000..8147840, y: -274840..-271000) downsampled from 1.0 m native grid to 30.0 m common analysis grid.
provenance.resamplingMethod: Stratified block-mean aggregation (2 x 30 = 60 native 1 m samples averaged per 30 m cell)
provenance.limitations: Low-relief alluvial plains (~65 m total relief); 30 m resampling smooths meter-scale aeolian ripples and Curiosity traverse tracks.
